title: PyPI Provenance
description: A PEP 740 provenance object representing digital attestations for a Python package distribution file. Contains one or more attestation bundles verified by PyPI, along with the Trusted Publisher identity that produced them.

version.description: The provenance object format version. Currently always 1.

attestation_bundles.description: One or more attestation bundles, each containing the publisher identity and a set of attestations.

AttestationBundle.description: A bundle of attestations produced by a single Trusted Publisher identity.

attestations.description: The attestation objects in this bundle.

Publisher.description: The Trusted Publisher identity that produced the attestations, verified through OpenID Connect.

kind.description: The type of Trusted Publisher, indicating the CI/CD platform.

claims.description: Identity claims from the OIDC token, such as repository and workflow information.

vendor-property.description: An optional vendor-specific property providing additional publisher context.

Attestation.description: A single attestation for a distribution file, containing the attestation type and a Sigstore bundle.

version.description: The attestation object version. Currently always 1.

verification_material.description: Sigstore verification material including the signing certificate and transparency log entries.

certificate.description: The base64-encoded signing certificate from the Sigstore CA.

transparency_entries.description: Entries from the Sigstore transparency log (Rekor).

envelope.description: The DSSE envelope containing the signed attestation statement.

signature.description: The base64-encoded signature over the statement.
